description: M5 item 4 — DunitFS v2 (allocation bitmap + extents, timestamps, mode, rename, unlink, fsync, superblock generations, metadata COW). First-boot acceptance on a freshly provisioned disk: the in-kernel smoke self-test (feature boot-smoke-tests) runs BEFORE auto_mount on a throwaway FS instance, then (1) formats a clean v2, (2) seeds a file, stages a metadata-only change and simulates a TORN commit, reloads and proves the loader rolls back to the last good superblock generation with file content intact, and (3) reformats and writes a persistence sentinel to be verified after reboot. auto_mount then still mounts the provisioned root at /persist, proving the format the installer wrote is the format the kernel loads. The reboot-persistence half is a separate --disk reuse run that must show '[DUNITFS-V2] persist reboot verified content=DUNIT-PERSIST-V2'. Run: tools/qemu_test.py --build-disk --config limine_test_terminal.conf --markers-file tools/m5_dunitfs_v2_markers.json

required.claim: writable AHCI target disk present for the self-test
clean empty v2 format succeeded (geometry + superblocks + slot bitmap)
an interrupted metadata commit was rejected by CRC and the loader rolled back to the last good superblock generation
the committed file content survived the torn metadata commit unchanged
persistence sentinel provisioned and committed for the reboot check
the installer-written v2 root is the format the kernel loads and mounts at /persist
the installed disk boots to the terminal after the self-test

forbidden.why: self-test could not find the disk — acceptance unproven
freshly formatted v2 did not load
could not create/commit the seed file
could not stage the simulated torn commit
wrong generation or corrupted content after a torn commit
FS unrecoverable after a torn commit
could not write the persistence sentinel
reformatted v2 did not load before writing the sentinel
sentinel survived reboot but with wrong content
